answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The trellis edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 156 clones produces a signature the ledge analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the saffron settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
